bug_description: Undefined behavior in cv::FillConvexPoly: left-shifting a negative int64 coordinate value when drawing shapes that extend beyond image boundaries. In modules/imgproc/src/drawing.cpp line 1121, the expression `p.x <<= XY_SHIFT - shift` is undefined behavior per C++ [expr.shift] when p.x is negative (e.g. -1 after clipping). The same pattern affects ThickLine, circle, ellipse, CollectPolyEdges, EllipseEx, and putText.

#!/bin/bash

build() {
    echo "BUILDING THE PROJECT..."
    if /usr/local/bin/compile 1>/dev/null; then
        echo "BUILD COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY!"
    else
        echo "BUILD FAILED!"
        exit 1
    fi
}

repro() {
    echo "REPRODUCING THE ISSUE FOR opencv.issue-28598..."
    export UBSAN_OPTIONS="halt_on_error=1:print_stacktrace=1"
    /src/harness_bin /testcase/poc.txt
    # NOTE: YOU SHOULD NOT RETURN/EXIT 0 IN THIS FUNCTION.
}

patch() {
    echo "PATCHING THE PROJECT..."
    cd /src/opencv
    if git apply /testcase/model_patch.diff; then
        echo "PATCH APPLIED SUCCESSFULLY!"
    else
        echo "PATCH APPLICATION FAILED!"
        exit 1
    fi
}

if [ "$#" -ge 1 ]; then
    command="$1"
    case "$command" in
        build) build "$@" ;;
        repro) repro "$@" ;;
        patch) patch "$@" ;;
        *) echo "Unknown command: $command"; echo "Usage: secb [build|repro|patch]"; exit 1 ;;
    esac
else
    echo "Usage: secb [build|repro|patch]"
    exit 1
fi

bug_report:
================= Bug Report (1/1) ==================
## Source: GitHub Issue
## URL: https://github.com/opencv/opencv/issues/28598
## Description:
Issue: opencv/opencv#28598
Title: UBSan: FillConvexPoly left shift of negative value
State: open
Created by: FuzzAnything-ORG
Created at: 2026-03-03
Labels: bug, category: imgproc
Milestone: 4.14.0

Issue Body:
In modules/imgproc/src/drawing.cpp, the function FillConvexPoly performs fixed-point coordinate scaling via left-shift on int64 values:

    p.x <<= XY_SHIFT - shift;  // Line 1121

When drawing shapes that extend beyond image boundaries (e.g., cv::Rect(-10, -10, 20, 20)), coordinates get clipped but can still be negative (e.g., p.x = -1). Left-shifting a negative signed integer is undefined behavior per the C++ standard.

Reproducer:
    cv::Mat img(32, 32, CV_8UC3, cv::Scalar(255, 255, 255));
    cv::rectangle(img, cv::Rect(-10, -10, 20, 20), cv::Scalar(0, 0, 255), -1);

UBSan output:
    /src/opencv/modules/imgproc/src/drawing.cpp:1121:10: runtime error: left shift of negative value -1

The same UB pattern affects multiple drawing functions: FillConvexPoly, ThickLine, circle, ellipse, CollectPolyEdges, EllipseEx, putText.

Version: 4.13.0
